title: Sightings at Los Alamos from 1948
summary: RedPandaKoala tells of Sightings at Los Alamos from 1948, about 1948 at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then you have Los Alamos, like even as early as I believe like 1948, they're being seen there.

plain: UFOs were being seen at Los Alamos, the New Mexico laboratory where the first atomic bombs were designed, as early as about 1948, according to the researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala, who mentions it briefly without naming a source. It is told as one more example of strange sightings clustering around America's nuclear sites from the very start.
